criteria.title: Problem definition
criteria.description: The engineering problem is real, specific and bounded. The ML task is correctly derived from it. The target variable is justified, not merely available. Assess the written justification and interpretation for this criterion. Numerical checks are scored separately. Do not infer correct code execution from prose. Unverifiable visual, repository-history or model-fitting claims must be flagged as concerns, not awarded as established facts.
